steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{A proper subset of a set A is a subset}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{B with }B\ne A.\\[5pt]&\text{For a non-empty set A, the empty set $\phi$}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{is always a proper subset ($\phi$ $\ne$ A).}\\[5pt]&\text{The empty set $\phi$ has only one subset,}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{which is $\phi$ itself, and $\phi$ = $\phi$, so it is}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{an improper subset.}\\[5pt]&\therefore \text{ Yes, the }\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{empty set $\phi$}}\text{ is the only}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{set which has no proper subset.}\end{aligned}\]
